# The Mechanical Toy Archive

A catalogued collection of antique mechanical toys — tin, clockwork, and battery-operated — assembled over decades by a private collector.

## What this site contains

- Over 650 individual toys, each with manufacturer, type, topic, mechanism, materials, dimensions, condition, and manufacturing dates
- 189 toy manufacturers, with history, country of origin, and founder information
- 142 reference books on antique mechanical toys
- Mechanism documentation for selected toys, with annotated photographs and technical descriptions

## Collections

- /collection — Full browsable archive of toys with filtering by type, topic, mechanism, and manufacturer
- /manufacturers — Directory of toy manufacturers
- /mechanisms — Internal mechanism documentation for selected toys
- /library — Reference bibliography

## About

The collection focuses on tin toys, clockwork mechanisms, and battery-operated novelties primarily from the 1930s–1980s, spanning manufacturers from Japan, Germany, the USA, the UK, France, Italy, and beyond.
